info.title: Business Partner Relationship (Version 1)
info.description: This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete business partner relationships for a specific supplier user ID. A business partner relationship maps the included supplier user ID to additional business entities, enabling the user ID to act on behalf of the any business entity that it is mapped to.

x-sap-shortText: Creates, reads, updates and deletes business partner relationships.

tags.name: Business Partner Relationships
tags.description: Operations on Business Partner Relationship header records (supplier users)

tags.name: Business Partner Linkages

get.summary: Retrieves a list of business partner relationships.
get.description: Retrieves a list of business partner relationship records. Supports OData query parameters for filtering by business partner number, email, name, and other fields. Use $expand=_MapBPToSupplierUser to include all Business Partner linkages for each record.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Filter the collection based on a boolean expression (e.g., BusinessPartner eq '9980000910'). See [$filter](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionfilter)

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Select specific properties to return (e.g., BusinessPartnerUUID,BusinessPartner,Department). See [$select](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionselect)

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: Expand related entities to include Business Partner linkages. See [$expand](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionexpand)

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Skip the first N records in the result set for pagination. See [$skip](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionskip)

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Return only the first N records from the result set. See [$top](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptiontop)

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: Include the total count of records in the response. See [$count](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptioncount)

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Order items by property values. See [$orderby](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionorderby)

post.summary: Creates a business partner relationship with Business Partner linkages.
post.description: Creates a new supplier user record along with one or more Business Partner linkages in a single deep insert request. The system auto-generates BusinessPartnerUUID and auto-fills FirstName, LastName, Email, Department from business user master data.

get.summary: Retrieves a single business partner relationship by UUID.
get.description: Retrieves a specific supplier user record by its UUID. Use $expand=_MapBPToSupplierUser to include all Business Partner linkages. To look up by business partner number instead of UUID, use GET /BPRelationship?$filter=BusinessPartner eq '{bp_number}'.

delete.summary: Deletes a supplier user and all Business Partner linkages.
delete.description: Deletes the supplier user record and cascades deletion to all associated Business Partner linkages. This operation cannot be undone.

get.summary: Retrieves all Business Partner linkages for a supplier user.
get.description: Retrieves all Business Partner linkages associated with the specified supplier user. Use $expand=_BPRelationHdr to include parent header details.

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: Expand related entities. Use _BPRelationHdr to include parent header.

post.summary: Adds a Business Partner linkage to an existing supplier user.
post.description: Creates a new Business Partner linkage for an existing supplier user. Only the linkage details need to be provided — BusinessPartner is automatically copied from the parent header record.

patch.description: Updates editable fields on an existing Business Partner linkage. Only send the fields you want to change. Updatable fields: Linkedbusinesspartnername, LogicalSystem.

delete.summary: Deletes a single Business Partner linkage.
delete.description: Removes a specific Business Partner linkage from a supplier user. The header record and other linkages remain intact.

BPRelationship.description: Represents a supplier user and their associated Business Partner linkages.

BusinessPartnerUUID.description: System-generated unique identifier for the supplier user record.

BusinessPartner.description: Business Partner number of the supplier user. Primary business key for lookup via $filter.

BusinessPartnerFirstName.description: First name of the supplier user. Auto-populated from business user master data. Read-only.

BusinessPartnerLastName.description: Last name of the supplier user. Auto-populated from business user master data. Read-only.

BusinessPartnerEmail.description: Email address of the supplier user. Auto-populated from business user master data. Read-only.

LogicalSystem.description: Header-level logical system field. Not used in current implementation — always returned as empty. Active logical system values are at the child linkage level.

CreatedAt.description: Timestamp of when this record was created. Auto-set by system. Read-only.

CreatedBy.description: User ID that created this record. Auto-set by system. Read-only.

LastChangedAt.description: Timestamp of most recent modification. Auto-updated by system. Read-only.

LastChangedBy.description: User ID that last modified this record. Auto-updated by system. Read-only.

Department.description: Department associated with the supplier user. Auto-derived from employee app.

IsMarkedForArchiving.description: Indicates whether the record is flagged for archiving. Read-only.

UserID.description: System user ID of the supplier user. Auto-populated. Read-only.

_MapBPToSupplierUser.description: Collection of Business Partner linkages for this supplier user.

BusinessPartner.description: Business Partner number of the supplier user. Must be a valid business user in the system.

Department.description: Department for the supplier user. Auto-derived from employee app.
